text:
maya: Customer reported sudden p95 spike ~12:30 after the model orchestration change. They saw intermittent 502s and some 429s. Need minimal repro artifacts to run a synthetic playback.

devon: Can you paste one or two request IDs and the route + model name? also which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

maya: Route is /v1/generate, model=rwd-extended-v2, hosted. Example request ids: r-20260317-9b7f and r-20260317-a2c4. Token counts ~ 120-450 depending on user.

james: Ok. i'll assemble a small promptset. maya, can you get a HAR or curl for one of those requests? HAR would be ideal for headers + timing.

maya: attaching HAR id: har://7fa3bb2c (from customer upload). also captured a short curl they used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-raw '{"model":"rwd-extended-v2","input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":300}'
```

devon: thanks. can you also include the `X-Request-Id` and `X-Trace-Id` headers from the HAR? i need them to pull proxy logs and the routing decision.

maya: X-Request-Id: r-20260317-9b7f, X-Trace-Id: trace-6d5e4b. added a snippet of the last 6xx lines from the customer's client logs: "socket timeout after 120s" and "connection reset by peer".

sre-bot: @devon I've queued a trace fetch for trace-6d5e4b. Collection id: trace-collect-3321. ETA ~ 6m.

james: For the playback plan i recommend: 1) small warmup 5 rps for 2 min to prime KV cache, 2) ramp to 50 concurrent users over 3 min, hold 5 min, 3) run 30s microbursts at 200 concurrent to stress autoscaler. Token matrix: short=100, medium=250, long=450. We'll run each prompt size 20 reps.

devon: i'll fetch infra logs for the times of the two request ids and pull per-shard GPU metrics (GPU util, mem, queue length). Also will take the host-side nginx timings.

maya: customer also reported a billing auth error slightly earlier: `401 invalid key` in ~1% of calls between 12:18-12:22. different request ids: r-20260317-b0c9. adding that to the bundle.

james: good to know — we'll include an auth test in the playback: mix in 1% bad-cred calls to see if rate-limited auth failures correlate with downstream routing knob.

tara: assigning: devon -> collect logs + HAR enrichment, james -> create synthetic playback harness and token matrix, maya -> coordinate customer uploads and provide a short promptset (5 seeds). i'll be on-call to monitor the run.

devon: started log collection. pulling proxy logs now; will post a short paste of key 200/502/429 lines once fetched.

maya: upload instructions I sent to customer for debug bundle: include HAR, client logs, minimal environment (region, SDK version), and a single redacted curl. asked them to add account id and request ids in a text file. they said they'll send within 30 minutes. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: debug-bundle-accept queued. link: s3://redwood-support/1932104567/debugbundle.zip (private).

james: once we have HAR + kibana snippets i'll run the playback in the staging region that mirrors their routing. will post a short results summary: p50/p95/p99, error rate, and where KV cache hit ratio changes.

maya: thanks all — if anyone spots anything odd in the trace-collect-3321 output, ping here and i'll ask the customer for more context. :pray:
